title: Best Full Length Mirror (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.

verdict.line: Picture a home gym that fits in a small space and offers live and on‑demand classes. The Mirror is ideal for anyone who wants a compact workout solution with a large display and instructor variety, but it comes with a high upfront cost and a monthly fee.
